label: Independent synthetic test - Chilled-water valve V-24

reports.work_area: Westline civic records center, chilled-water branch V-24
reports.work_planned: Stage the replacement valve and prepare the agreed branch shutdown.
reports.work_completed: Replacement valve delivered, inspected against the approved mechanical schedule, and accepted into the secure store. Access platform and drip trays installed.
reports.materials_equipment: Chilled-water control valve, recovery tank, pipe fitting tools, electrical test meter
reports.issue_or_update: Routine preparation completed. The shutdown permit has been requested for the replacement window.
reports.schedule_status: Valve replacement planned after the shutdown permit and interface instruction are released.
reports.rfi_change_order_refs: Work order WO-V24; mechanical schedule MS-24 revision C
reports.action_required: Obtain the shutdown permit before disturbing the pipework.
reports.quantity_or_measurement: Two identical valves delivered; one allocated to V-24 and one retained as the approved spare
reports.supporting_evidence: Goods receipt GR-V24-18 and accepted delivery inspection DI-V24-18 filed

reports.work_area: Westline civic records center, chilled-water branch V-24
reports.work_planned: Remove and replace valve V-24 after receipt of the written isolation release and control interface detail.
reports.work_completed: No pipework opened. Crew held at the work area from 08:00 to 11:20, then reassigned to install pipe supports in the adjoining plant space.
reports.materials_equipment: Chilled-water control valve, recovery tank, pipe fitting tools, electrical test meter
reports.issue_or_update: Building operator verbally advised the supervisor at 08:10 that the isolation was proved. The signed isolation certificate was not available to this crew at 11:20. The released actuator interface detail was also awaited.
reports.schedule_status: The V-24 replacement window was deferred. Recorded work-area hold was 3 hours 20 minutes; no project completion-date effect has been calculated.
reports.rfi_change_order_refs: WO-V24; isolation certificate requested; technical query TQ-074
reports.action_required: Provide the signed isolation certificate and the released actuator interface instruction before opening the branch.
reports.quantity_or_measurement: Four installers held for 3 hours 20 minutes before reassignment; valves replaced: 0

reports.work_area: Westline civic records center, chilled-water branch V-24
reports.work_planned: Confirm branch isolation and resolve the actuator interface.
reports.work_completed: Coordination call completed at 09:15. Designer reviewed the actuator submittal and circulated an internal draft.
reports.materials_equipment: Chilled-water control valve, recovery tank, pipe fitting tools, electrical test meter
reports.issue_or_update: Coordinator notes state isolation proved, based on the operator's telephone call; the signed isolation certificate was awaiting issue at 14:00. Existing controls drawing E-620 revision F calls for 0-10 V, while the approved replacement actuator submittal lists 4-20 mA. The internal draft proposes retaining 0-10 V, but has not been approved or entered in the document register.
reports.schedule_status: Branch opening remains dependent on the signed isolation release. Installer has not received an issued control-interface instruction.
reports.rfi_change_order_refs: TQ-074; E-620 revision F; actuator submittal AS-V24-06
reports.action_required: Issue the final TQ-074 response and controls drawing revision, and confirm installer receipt.
reports.quantity_or_measurement: Existing controls signal: 0-10 V; replacement submittal: 4-20 mA
reports.supporting_evidence: Coordination note SC-V24-19 and internal draft email

reports.work_area: Westline civic records center, chilled-water branch V-24
reports.work_planned: Verify the branch isolation and issue the signed certificate.
reports.work_completed: Isolation verified at 08:15. Signed certificate ISO-V24-0820 issued at 08:35 and received by the mechanical supervisor at 08:43.
reports.materials_equipment: Chilled-water control valve, recovery tank, pipe fitting tools, electrical test meter
reports.issue_or_update: Written branch-isolation acceptance is complete. This certificate authorises the isolated pipework to be opened; it does not constitute acceptance of the replacement pressure test.
reports.schedule_status: Isolation release closed. Replacement pipework requires a separate witnessed pressure test before insulation is reinstated.
reports.action_required: Arrange the separate replacement-pipework pressure-test witness before reinstating insulation.
reports.supporting_evidence: Signed ISO-V24-0820 certificate and receipt acknowledgement filed

reports.work_area: Westline civic records center, chilled-water branch V-24
reports.work_planned: Release the final actuator interface decision.
reports.work_completed: Signed TQ-074 response and E-620 revision H issued at 10:10, specifying 4-20 mA for the replacement actuator. Mechanical and controls supervisors acknowledged receipt at 10:25.
reports.materials_equipment: Chilled-water control valve, recovery tank, pipe fitting tools, electrical test meter
reports.issue_or_update: TQ-074 is closed. Revision H supersedes the earlier 0-10 V instruction and the unapproved internal draft.
reports.schedule_status: Final control-interface information is available to both installation trades. The valve replacement is booked into the next agreed branch access window on August 21.
reports.action_required: Use E-620 revision H for actuator wiring and later functional verification.
reports.supporting_evidence: Signed TQ-074 response, revision H drawing, and both receipt acknowledgements filed

reports.work_area: Westline civic records center, chilled-water branch V-24
reports.work_planned: Replace V-24 in the agreed isolated branch window.
reports.work_completed: Old valve removed and replacement installed. Mechanical fitting completed at 13:40. Recovery-tank meter recorded 360 L removed from the branch. The approved spare valve remained sealed in the store.
reports.materials_equipment: Chilled-water control valve, recovery tank, pipe fitting tools, electrical test meter
reports.issue_or_update: Valve replacement is physically complete following the deferred August 19 window. Pressure-test witness requested for the next morning.
reports.schedule_status: Branch remains under the agreed isolation. Insulation reinstatement awaits pressure-test acceptance; automatic operation awaits controls functional checks.
reports.action_required: Complete the witnessed pressure test and retain the acceptance record before insulation reinstatement.
reports.quantity_or_measurement: One valve installed; one sealed spare in store; 360 L recovered as measured by tank meter
reports.supporting_evidence: Installation check sheet MI-V24-21 and recovery meter log RM-V24-21 filed

reports.work_area: Westline civic records center, chilled-water branch V-24
reports.work_planned: Check pressure-test closeout and recovered-fluid disposal records.
reports.work_completed: Pressure-test reference PT-V24-0822 entered in the work package. Recovered-fluid collector supplied signed transfer record WT-884.
reports.materials_equipment: Chilled-water control valve, recovery tank, pipe fitting tools, electrical test meter
reports.issue_or_update: The signed PT-V24-0822 acceptance sheet is not linked and could not be accessed during this review. The reference alone does not show the test result. WT-884 lists 300 L collected, while RM-V24-21 records 360 L recovered. The 60 L difference is not reconciled in the transfer record or the site tank balance.
reports.schedule_status: Pressure-test acceptance requires record verification before insulation closeout. Fluid quantity reconciliation remains open.
reports.action_required: Link the signed pressure-test acceptance and reconcile the 60 L difference against collection and tank-balance records.
reports.quantity_or_measurement: 360 L recovered; 300 L on signed transfer record; 60 L unreconciled
reports.supporting_evidence: PT-V24-0822 register reference, signed WT-884 transfer record, and RM-V24-21 meter log

reports.work_area: Westline civic records center, chilled-water branch V-24
reports.work_planned: Connect the replacement actuator using the issued interface instruction.
reports.work_completed: Actuator wired to E-620 revision H. Local manual stroke exercise completed. Cable labels and point identifiers checked and accepted.
reports.materials_equipment: Chilled-water control valve, recovery tank, pipe fitting tools, electrical test meter
reports.issue_or_update: Remote building-management-system command, feedback, and fail-safe-position tests have not yet been performed. The local stroke exercise is not the remote functional acceptance.
reports.schedule_status: Branch remains out of automatic service pending the remote functional tests booked for August 24. No failed remote test is reported.
reports.rfi_change_order_refs: E-620 revision H; commissioning checklist CC-V24-22
reports.action_required: Complete and record the remote command, feedback, and fail-safe-position tests before returning the branch to automatic service.
reports.quantity_or_measurement: One actuator locally exercised; remote functional acceptance outstanding
reports.supporting_evidence: Wiring inspection WI-V24-22 accepted; local exercise entry in CC-V24-22
